scope: Evaluate exactly the single frozen external replication contrast in research/m2-type-i-external-replication-prereg-v1.json. No alternate threshold, endpoint, subgroup or symbol subset may replace the primary test.
operational_retry_policy: Each symbol uses the frozen provider order with internal retry/failover. The completed replication run is consumed regardless of confirm/not_confirmed/inconclusive; do not rerun to seek a different statistical outcome.
closeout_policy: After the first completed evaluation artifact is captured, persist the result in research/, set authorized=false and one_time_external_replication=false, and replace CI evaluation with frozen-result verification.
